metadata.name: UpdateAccountAlerts
metadata.description: The purpose of this API is to opt in the account alerts and also the user can update the alert parameters.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Account number. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 8000000000000037 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid). Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

request_fields.name: EmailID
request_fields.description: Email Id in which Email Alerts need to be send Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 256

request_fields.name: AlertDate
request_fields.description: Date in which alert setup process being invoke

request_fields.name: MobileCarrier
request_fields.description: Carrier of Mobile Phone number Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: MobilePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Mobile Phone Number in which SMS Alert need to be send Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: AlertStatus
request_fields.description: It shows current Alert status for particular user account. 1 - Active Alert and 2 - Stop Alert. Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: AccountAlertsList
request_fields.description: AccountAlertsList

request_fields.name: MessageID
request_fields.description: A unique message id to identify each alert Allowable Values: 6

request_fields.name: MessageCategory
request_fields.description: Category of Alert Example: Status, Monetary, Period, Cards, Security Allowable Values: 8

request_fields.name: MessageStatus
request_fields.description: Current Status of Alert whether it is active or not Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: MessageTemplate
request_fields.description: Template Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: Operand
request_fields.description: Operand to define condition of Alerts Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: Amount
request_fields.description: Amount to define condition of Alerts

request_fields.name: AtWhatTime
request_fields.description: Time when Alert should get trigger Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: StatusCHUpdate
request_fields.description: It shows whether a Cardholder can over write this alert or not

request_fields.name: ThresholdDays
request_fields.description: Applicable only for MessageCategory Status and Monetary to decide alert send threshold date Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: IsEmailAlert
request_fields.description: Indicator for Email type of Alerts Valid Values: true/false Example: true

request_fields.name: IsMobileAlert
request_fields.description: Indicator for SMS type of Alerts Valid Values: true/false Example: true

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10
